title: A-Pillar Speaker — SYNC
introduction: The A-pillar speaker sits in the trim panel beside the windshield. I approach it like nested snap-fit lids: free the trim panel first, then release the speaker’s own tabs. The coupe and convertible have different access arrangements, so choose your body style before starting. This procedure covers removal and refitting on vehicles with SYNC.

items.name: Choose the matching body style
items.detail: Use the convertible access sequence or the coupe access sequence below.

items.name: Recognize the illustrated side
items.detail: Both trim references show LHD; RHD is similar. They show the RH side; the LH side is similar.

items.name: Complete the required safety review
items.detail: Before beginning this repair, carefully review [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189), including its general service warnings. Review the safety references linked there for every listed system involved in your work before working on that system. Those applicable system references remain required reading; the precautions here do not replace them.

items.name: Prevent remote starting
items.detail: Before service requiring work underneath or around the vehicle, disable the remote start feature, if equipped, through the Central Display at Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Otherwise, the vehicle could be remotely started at any time, potentially causing personal injury or death.

items.name: Remove the key
items.detail: Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person from starting the engine during service. An accidental start may cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Wear protective equipment
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection when servicing the vehicle. Wear protective gloves when handling parts with pointed or sharp edges. Failure to follow either precaution may result in serious personal injury.

edits.text:
Remove the A-Pillar trim panel using the access sequence for your body style.
Refer to: [A-Pillar Trim Panel - Convertible](#/document/G1692609) (501-05 Interior Trim and Ornamentation, Removal and Installation).
Refer to: [A-Pillar Trim Panel - Coupe](#/document/G1692599) (501-05 Interior Trim and Ornamentation, Removal and Installation).
edits.why: Removing the panel exposes the speaker’s retaining tabs. For a convertible, remove the sun visor cap, release the clip, then remove the visor; the curved arrow in the visor illustration shows its removal movement. If equipped, disconnect the visor electrical connector. Next, release the A-pillar trim retainers, disconnect the speaker electrical connector if equipped, then release the clips and remove the trim panel in the illustrated direction. For a coupe, remove the pin-type retainer shown at the lower end of the door weatherstrip and position the weatherstrip aside. Release the trim clips and disconnect the tether anchor, disconnect the speaker electrical connector if equipped, then release the remaining clips and remove the panel. I check the coupe tether before treating the panel as free: released clips do not mean that attachment has also been disconnected.

edits.text: Release the A-Pillar speaker’s retaining tabs highlighted in magenta, then remove the speaker in the direction of the arrow on the blue component.
edits.why: I use the arrows around the speaker’s edge to identify the tab-release movements. The separate arrow on the speaker shows its removal movement after those tabs stop holding it in the panel.

edits.text: Reverse the removal sequence to install: refit the A-Pillar speaker and engage its retaining tabs, then reinstall the A-Pillar trim panel and the access parts for your body style.
edits.why: I check that the tabs retain the speaker before enclosing it with the trim. For a convertible, refit the panel by engaging the clips, reconnecting the speaker electrical connector if equipped, and securing the retainers. Reconnect the visor electrical connector if equipped, refit the visor, engage its clip, and reinstall its cap. For a coupe, engage the panel clips, reconnect the speaker electrical connector if equipped, reconnect the tether anchor and engage the remaining clips. Return the door weatherstrip to position and reinstall its pin-type retainer. Completion means restoring the speaker retention, electrical connections and body-style-specific attachments released during removal.
